supersedes.scope: Supersedes verdict-1 only as the verdict of record for per-stratum witnesses, the fixed-32 margins derived from them and the minimum margin. Candidate verdicts, counts, budget, scope and classification are carried unchanged.

classification: All four frozen selected converged candidates fail calibration and validation at1x/2x. Local fitted failure, NOT coefficient-independent/global family rejection; no surviving stroke candidate for implementation/exposure.

correction.what: Verdict-1 copied each saved summary's worstBoundExcess as its decidingWitness. That scoring.summarize label ranges over every non-null channel reading, censored status included. For device-M1/leastSquares light-inactive/calibration/1x it names g255-c-c44__inactive arc shell 1 bin 2 R median, status censored-bound-satisfied: 2 rail pixels (satisfied) and 5.133836 codes over its 5 uncensored pixels.
correction.scientificStatus: The verdict-1 row was not a false failure. instrument.score_bin sets failed=true when the uncensored-pixel mean exceeds max(1,bar) even beside a satisfied rail, and bounds-declaration.txt line 163 declares that "an uncensored failure remains binding beside any censored channel"; the saved row carries failed=true in the median and all seven repeats. The flaw is reporting: a censored-status channel was presented as the deciding witness without its status qualification, and its fixed-32 margin mixed a censored-status reading into a measured-accuracy statement.
correction.fix: Verdict-2 cites, on every stratum, a conservative measured-only witness: a median channel with status measured and failed=true whose seven repeats are also all measured and failed, with the largest median excess over max(1,bar). Only the device-M1/leastSquares calibration/1x witness changes; the other fifteen equal verdict-1's (location, channel, repeat and codes identical). No candidate verdict changes: all four selected candidates still fail both roles at both scales.

boundRule.bound: max(1, bar[channel]); bar = 0.5 + 0.5 * range over the seven repeats of the bin's per-repeat channel mean (instrument.score_bin; declaration line 20 "Bar per channel/bin is 0.5 + half the run-to-run range"; W39 clause 8 and the V2 addendum "max(1,bar)"). scoring.summarize reports the same bound.
boundRule.observed: Every one of the sixteen witnesses has bar 0.5 on its channel, so bound 1.0.
boundRule.measuredFailed: status "measured" means no rail pixel in that channel of that reading, so failed=true there is exactly error > max(1,bar); the replay asserts it.

fixed32BoundDerivation: For a fixed prediction, per-pixel |p32-p16| <= D, D the stratum maximum of the saved per-bin maximumPixelDifferenceRGB over all channels (recomputed from *-quadrature.jsonl.gz and required to equal the summary's recorded value). On a measured channel every pixel is uncensored and the target (median or repeat) is prediction-independent, so the triangle inequality gives MAE32 >= MAE16 - D, and remaining excess >= MAE16 - D - max(1,bar). No 32-point coefficients were fitted.
scope: Only light inactive archive payloads admitted by metadata before reading; M2 remains unfrozen/unavailable and certified endpoint scopes are not fitted.
authority: LOCAL fitted failure of the four frozen selected converged candidates; NOT a coefficient-independent or global rejection of the M1 family.
